core_meaning.primary_meaning: Latifi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Of Latif; belonging to Latif”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Latifi corresponds to the Arabic form لطيفي (Nisba of لَطِيف; لَطِيفِيّ (Laṭīfiyy)). Its core sense is latifi; of latif, belonging to latif. Latifi is Arabic لَطِيفِيّ (Laṭīfiyy), the nisba of لَطِيف (Laṭīf), meaning 'of Latif; belonging to Latif'. The source gloss 'The Giver, Benefactor' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.
